motions.motion_name_zh: 左前爪轻擦左耳与脸部后恢复坐姿
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 16 frames at 4 fps: seated tabby lifts its own left forepaw (viewer right), touches the left ear/head side, sweeps down across its face, lowers the paw, and resumes sitting. Original video is 4 seconds, 24 fps, 720x1280, with an audio track.

motions.motion_name_zh: 右前爪轻擦右耳与脸部后恢复坐姿
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: exact mirrored right-paw grooming, paw up near 1s, right ear contact 1.3-1.8s, muzzle lick 2-2.4s, seated by 2.7s. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280; audio removed at runtime.

motions.motion_name_zh: 左前爪坐姿拨打逗猫棒后注视玩具
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: tan feather wand at chest from screen-right; seated own-left-paw bats about 0.7-1.7s; paw down by 2.1s; watches toy to screen-right until end. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280.

motions.motion_name_zh: 右前爪坐姿拨打逗猫棒后注视玩具
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: tan feather wand at chest from screen-left; seated own-right-paw bats about 0.7-1.7s; paw down by 2.1s; watches toy to screen-left until end. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280.

motions.motion_name_zh: 起身向画面右侧追拍逗猫棒并站定
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: dark rod at screen-right; support own-left forepaw, own-right paw crosses toward toy 0.7-1.6s; hips rise and step toward screen-right; all-four-paw standing finish by 2.2s. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280. Additional 6fps detail review at 0.5-1.7s confirms repeated cross-body swats with the same forepaw.

motions.motion_name_zh: 起身向画面左侧追拍逗猫棒并站定
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: dark rod at screen-left; support own-right forepaw, own-left paw crosses toward toy 0.7-1.6s; hips rise and step toward screen-left; all-four-paw standing finish by 2.2s. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280. Additional 6fps detail review at 0.5-1.7s confirms repeated cross-body swats with the same forepaw.

motions.motion_name_zh: 双前爪抬起抓扑逗猫棒后落地坐定
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: dark feather rod from right; both paws lift at 0.7-1.1s with brief rear-up over hind feet; two-paw forward/down landing at 1.2-1.5s; reseated by 2.2s, toy before muzzle at end. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280.

motions.motion_name_zh: 追扑从画面左向右滚动的毛线球并按住
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: pink yarn ball rolls screen-left to screen-right 0-1.6s; crouch 1.6-2.1s; single forward pounce 2.1-2.7s; standing over ball held between forepaws 2.8-4s. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280.

motions.motion_name_zh: 追扑从画面右向左滚动的毛线球并按住
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: pink yarn ball rolls screen-right to screen-left 0-1.6s; crouch 1.6-2.1s; single forward pounce 2.1-2.7s; standing over ball held between forepaws 2.8-4s. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280.

motions.motion_name_zh: 低头向画面左侧蜷卧并闭眼休息
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: seated head lowers 0-1s; chest and forelegs fold 1-2s; compact lying curl by 2.7s, head screen-left, rump screen-right, eyes closed to end. 4s, 24fps, 720x1280. Original unmirrored filename intentionally retains its leading space.

motions.motion_name_zh: 起身向镜头走近并在近处站定
motions.source_observation: Reviewed 12 frames at 3 fps: seated 0-0.9s; rises with own-left forepaw advancing near 1.2s; alternating forward walking 1.3-2.8s; close front-facing stand and slight head inclination about 3-4.042s. 97 frames, ~24fps, 720x1280. Target request 4s; source duration retained for validation.
